title: Finishing together without a perfect moment

captions.energy: Postponing your wish for the other

meaning: Completed pleasure becomes mutual when waiting for a moment convenient to the other allows your own wish to be expressed.
text: A shared pleasure can be complete in form while meeting it is still postponed. The World in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps bring an enjoyable activity into a whole. The Hanged Man in energy leans towards suspending your wish for the other. The Lovers in emotions offer joy in mutual choice. That becomes more available when each can say what is wanted now, instead of hoping agreement will somehow appear at a moment when nobody needs to ask.

For example, you finish making a paper lantern for a cosy evening. Everything is ready, but each proposes first doing whatever the other would enjoy. **Reciprocity can begin with a plainly expressed wish.** You can say that lighting the lantern and sitting beside each other appeals, then hear the answer. Freely given agreement loses no value because it was requested. The finished object finally becomes part of leisure rather than a sign of another pleasure postponed.

The difficulty is treating mutual yielding as closeness already achieved. The evening passes in offers to wait, although both want a simple shared moment. A small clear choice restores movement without pressure. If wishes differ, a brief overlap can be chosen, beyond requiring one person to sacrifice an entire rest for an attractive conclusion to the idea.
